data.body: CI follow-up under rebar-debug: change 991 failed one test on Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13. Runtime instrumentation proved the default attested run had active/current and cfg roots on the immutable snapshot while the test prompt existed only in the mutable checkout. The discriminating matrix was attested+uncommitted=FAIL unknown prompt, local+uncommitted=PASS, attested+committed=PASS. This proves production root coherence is correct and the June fixture was stale against the July attested-by-default contract. The fixture now commits its project prompt before running. Removing that commit mutation returns the test to RED; restoring it yields 2/2 execution-mode tests green. All 97 touched-file tests passed; make check passed; the full default selection passed under xdist: 7313 passed, 29 skipped. Amended commit b3953a0da preserves Change-Id I07ccfc6ae851908eb4cbf291e37b8a093b5dc2db and the ticket/DCO trailers.
